name: mibi-adult-S16-b
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan, proportions and colours only, a crude 3D blockout to be painted over: a wisp of lightning: a pale lavender tall slim body with a round head on a thin neck, floating, with three pointed fins below.
The species' signed silhouette (project-owned): the adult's outline.
prompt: Paint the ADULT of the creature in the references, keeping its body plan (a floating wisp: a round head on a slim neck, a tall smooth teardrop body, three soft pointed fins below) but NOT the blockout's stiff geometry: soft, rounded, living forms. It has a FACE: two large dark glossy eyes with a pale highlight and a small calm mouth, on the front of the round head. Colour: a soft purple-lilac skin with small darker violet spots scattered over the head and body, painted into the skin. This is the species' BARE BASE picture: nothing added on top. It floats a little above its soft shadow. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, smooth painted forms, gentle shading, light from the top left. Three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, calm. One creature, centred, large, on a plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with nothing else. No outline glow, no text, no ground, no props, no people. Never childish: a grown animal, not a baby.
